author: Kwevlo
quote:
Im 44% in and feel incredibly dissapointed in the game, there is no funny cutscenes, Jason has the charisma of a wet paper towl. Beginning especially feels like a boyfriend simulator and Lucia is absolutely jarring. They removed features from previous titles, example is hookers, additional relationships etc. Planes dont even have good and realistic impact onto objects/buildings and u would expect that from a game that aspires realism. Bugs and glitches were alot of as well such as falling through the map. Censored nude seens are crazy as well, especially since its a adult game, so u spend all this time pampering Lucia and u basically get nothing for it. Content thats cut unless u have the ultimate edition, 30 fps cap is really noticeable, especially in shoot outs when it can even drop to 20 to 25.
GTA 5 was far better for its time, and outclasses the story in any way, shape or form.

Anyway, thats my review.
